notes: Plan 7 Track S draft: one summon per divine spell level in two flavours, beasts and celestials for good or neutral casters and undead for evil ones (the Callings in spells.json). Stats rise with the level, roughly a 5e creature of CR 1/2 at level 1 to CR 13 at level 9. Names echo SRD 5.1 creatures; the descriptions are ours.

entries.name: Spirit hound
entries.description: A grey hound of mist that snaps and darts back.

entries.name: Cave bear
entries.description: A shaggy bulk of claws that charges whatever is nearest.

entries.name: Warden stag
entries.description: An antlered stag of the old woods whose bellow puts heart into the party.

entries.name: Unicorn
entries.description: A white horse with a spiralled horn that gores and wheels away.

entries.name: Couatl
entries.description: A feathered serpent that spits radiance onto a tile.

entries.name: Deva
entries.description: A winged messenger with a heavy mace and a voice like a bell.

entries.name: Roc
entries.description: A bird big enough to carry off an ox, and willing to try.

entries.name: Planetar
entries.description: A towering warrior of the heavens with a greatsword of light.

entries.name: Solar
entries.description: The mightiest of the heavenly host, whose arrows do not miss often.

entries.name: Skeleton archer
entries.description: Rattling bones with a bow, shooting from the back.

entries.name: Ghoul
entries.description: A grave-eater that claws and slinks back out of reach.

entries.name: Ogre zombie
entries.description: A dead ogre that lurches forward and swings a tree trunk.

entries.name: Wight
entries.description: A cold-eyed dead captain that drives the living into the fray.

entries.name: Wraith
entries.description: A shadow with burning eyes whose touch drinks warmth.

entries.name: Mummy
entries.description: A wrapped corpse of an old king, slow and terribly strong.

entries.name: Bone sorcerer
entries.description: A dead mage still muttering spells that blight a whole tile.

entries.name: Grave knight
entries.description: A dead knight on a dead horse, still keeping its old oaths in its own way.

entries.name: Bone dragon
entries.description: The bare skeleton of a dragon, raised and furious.
